zh: 社会主义之后的俄罗斯
en: RUSSIA AFTER SOCIALISM

zh: 1989年中欧“现实社会主义”的终结，以及1991年俄国的终结，在受影响的国家以及外部世界激起了一阵欢欣的浪潮，仿佛1848年“民族之春”的重演。在东方，公民们期待终于能生活在一个“正常社会”里；他们所谓正常，不仅指西方式的富足——尽管部分也指这个——还指一种不受意识形态政治无所不在的扭曲所左右的生活。在西方，则涌起一股胜利主义情绪，期待自由主义的“市场民主”取得普世胜利。在中欧，这种欢欣大约持续了一年半，在前苏联甚至不到半年；西方则异口同声地警觉起来。的确，共产主义尸骨未寒，人们便听到关于法西斯未来的种种预言——用当时的新调子说，就是“魏玛俄罗斯”的前景。
en: The end of “real socialism” in Central Europe in 1989, and then in Russia in 1991, unleashed a wave of euphoria in the affected countries and in the outside world, as if in a replay of the “Springtime of the Peoples” of 1848. In the East, citizens anticipated living at last in a “normal society,” by which they meant not just Western-style affluence—although they meant that in part—but also an existence free from the omnipresent distortions of ideological politics. And in the West, there was a surge of triumphalism in anticipation of the universal victory of liberal “market democracy.” In Central Europe the euphoria lasted perhaps a year and a half, and in the former Soviet Union not even half a year; and the West in unison took alarm. Indeed, Communism was not yet cold in its grave when prophecies were heard of a looming fascist future—the scenario of “Weimar Russia,” as the new refrain went.

zh: 而整个前苏联世界的问题确实令人震惊：经济持续恶化，一种恶劣的民族主义在一些地区引发流血冲突，民众则被通货膨胀、日益猖獗的无法无天和普遍的不安全感弄得无所适从。至于西方，当它开始意识到并不存在整齐的“民主转型”，而且无论发生什么积极变化都将耗费西方大量金钱、带来无穷麻烦时，胜利主义便消退了。就连一度看来最容易复兴的东德，也证明负担沉重，把直布罗陀般的西德经济拖入深度衰退。人们很快发现，冷战的结束不会带来任何“和平红利”，而且它确实给世界留下了核扩散的严重风险。
en: And the problems were indeed staggering throughout the whole ex-Soviet world: the economy continued to deteriorate, a nasty form of nationalism led to bloody strife in some areas, and the populations were disoriented by inflation, growing lawlessness, and general insecurity. As for the West, triumphalism waned when it began to dawn that no neat “transition to democracy” was taking place and that whatever positive change was occurring would cost the West much money and many headaches. Even East Germany, which once looked like the easiest area to revive, proved so burdensome that it plunged the Gibraltar-like West German economy into deep recession. It soon became apparent that the end of the Cold War would yield no “peace dividend” and that it had indeed left the world with grave new possibilities of nuclear proliferation.

zh: 然而，尽管东方和西方人人皆感意外，这一结局其实本不应令人意外，只要想想现实社会主义在其全盛时期究竟是什么样子。毕竟，苏维埃主义曾是一个“单一组织化”的制度：从党到计划再到政治警察，一切都在结构上和功能上相互关联。因此，理应预料到一个总体制度会总体崩溃，从而留下一个总体问题：党瓦解为近乎行政无政府状态；计划崩溃为近乎以物易物；联盟碎裂为多个相互竞争的民族主权体——而所有这些内爆同时发生。所以，要爬出这片普遍的“瓦砾”——借用索尔仁尼琴的比喻——就必须同时做所有事情，从而造成一个不可能的局面：从逻辑上说，每一件事都必须首先完成。这就是以向内崩塌（而非向外突破）方式进行的反社会主义革命的历史特殊性，也使1991年八月变革是否构成革命变得模糊不清。于是，制度的逻辑甚至在它进入坟墓之后仍继续运作。
en: Yet, though everyone in both the East and the West was surprised, this outcome should not in fact have been surprising, given what real socialism had been in its day. For Sovietism, after all, had been a “mono-organizational” system in which everything, from Party to Plan to political police, had been structurally and functionally interrelated. Thus, it was only to be expected that a total system should collapse totally, and hence leave behind a total problem: The Party dissolved into near administrative anarchy; the Plan imploded into near barter; and the Union fragmented into multiple contending national sovereignties—and all of these implosions occurred simultaneously. So to climb out from under this universal “rubble,” to use Solzhenitsyn’s metaphor, everything would have to be done at once, thus creating an impossible situation where everything, logically, had to be done first. This is the historical particularity of antisocialist revolution by implosion (rather than breakthrough), and hence the source of the ambiguity surrounding the revolutionary status of August 1991. And so the logic of the system continued to operate even from beyond the grave.

zh: 这种困境正是一句常被引用的俏皮话的含义。这句话对苏维埃主义如此普遍适用，以至于人们曾把它分别归于莱赫·瓦文萨和俄国幽默家米哈伊尔·日瓦涅茨基：把鱼缸做成鱼汤容易，却还没有人找到把鱼汤变回鱼缸的办法。列宁在1918年战时共产主义下用八个月时间把俄国的公民社会剁成没有市场、没有法律的糊状物；鲍里斯·叶利钦——以及他的继任者——将需要一代人的时间，才能让俄国重新变成一个有活鱼游动的鱼缸。这样的局面、这样的难题，在世界历史上没有先例；也没有人知道反向转化的配方。因此，俄国只能在仍泡在汤里的时候，即兴摸索重返“正常社会”之路。而外部世界则应当做好长期给予同情和援助的准备。
en: This dilemma is the meaning of an oft-quoted witticism so universally applicable to Sovietism that it has been variously attributed to Lech Walesa and to the Russian humorist Mikhail Zhvanetskii: It is easy to make fish soup out of an aquarium, but no one has yet found a way to make an aquarium out of fish soup. Lenin minced Russian civil society into a marketless, lawless puree in eight months under War Communism in 1918; Boris Yeltsin—and his successors—will require a generation to make Russia once again into a living, vertebrate aquarium. Such a situation, and such a conundrum, is without precedent in world history; and no one knows the recipe for the reverse transformation. Thus Russia will have to improvise, while still in the soup, her return to a “normal society.” And the outside world should brace itself for a very long haul of empathy and aid.

zh: 这种“正常”社会的性质，通常被定义为“市场民主”（顺便说，这个说法会让从斯密到凯恩斯的任何经济学家，或从杰斐逊到威尔逊的任何民主倡导者感到惊讶：正是苏联的崩溃才赋予它意义）。但对俄国来说，如今向这样一个社会过渡，也许比1914年时更为困难。
en: The nature of this “normal” society is conventionally defined as a “market democracy” (an expression, incidentally, that would have amazed any economist from Smith to Keynes, or any advocate of democracy from Jefferson to Wilson: it took the Soviet collapse to give it meaning). But the transition to such a society is probably more difficult now for Russia than it would have been in 1914.

zh: 历史证据表明，创造成熟市场经济所需的众多制度，比建立政治民主要艰巨得多。1914年的俄国已经具备市场社会的基本要素；如果能顺利应对与专制决裂的革命风险，在这些要素之上再加上一个宪政制度，本来并非内在困难之事。如已指出的，
成功过渡的主要内部障碍，是1914年俄国在社会学上的不成熟，尤其是农民阶级的份量过大，而他们大多没有私有财产，也没有发达的现代民法意识。当然，正是这一因素，加上战争造成的混乱，抵消了俄国市场兼公民社会的前景，使布尔什维克得以夺取政权。
en: The historical evidence indicates that it is a much more arduous task to create the myriad institutions that make a mature market economy than it is to fashion a political democracy. Russia in 1914 already had the basic ingredients of a market society; adding to these a constitutional regime would not have been an intrinsically difficult matter if the hazards of the revolutionary break with autocracy could have been negotiated successfully. The main internal impediment to a successful transition was, as already indicated,

Russia’s sociological immaturity in 1914, and in particular the inordinate weight of a peasantry largely without private property or a developed sense of modern civil law. And it is this factor, of course, in conjunction with the dislocations of the war, that cancelled out the promise of Russia’s market-cum-civil-society and permitted the Bolsheviks to seize power.

zh: 然而在1991年之后，俄国虽然幸运地免于国际战争的压力，却面临一套远为困难的内部问题。她必须建立自由经济秩序，同时设计民主政体；此外还得创建一个俄罗斯民族国家。因为我们不应忘记，在共产主义垮台之前，并不存在1991年后的俄罗斯联邦这样的实体。
en: After 1991, however, Russia, though fortunately free of the pressures of international war, faces a far more difficult set of internal problems. She has to build a liberal economic order while simultaneously devising a democratic polity; and into the bargain she has to create a Russian nation-state. For we should not forget that no such entity as the post-1991 Russian Federation existed before the fall of Communism.

zh: 自十六世纪伊凡雷帝征服伏尔加河流域的喀山和阿斯特拉罕汗国以来，由莫斯科和圣彼得堡统治的国家从来就不是一个民族国家；它是一个多民族帝国，其凝聚原则在1917年以前是王朝，此后则是党。必须从这具帝国残躯中形成一个现代民族，同时它必须实行分权和联邦制，以消除苏联伪联邦的超中央集权所造成的损害。此外，这些重建和新创的多重任务在功能上相互关联，因此若要各自成功，就必须同时推进。这就是重建1917年被砸碎的公民鱼缸所必需的惊人努力。
en: Ever since Ivan the Terrible conquered the Volga Khanates of Kazan and Astrakhan in the sixteenth century, the state that was ruled from Moscow and St. Petersburg never was a nation-state; it was a multinational empire whose principle of cohesion until 1917 had been dynastic, and after that date had been the Party. Out of this rump of empire a modern nation must be formed, one that will at the same time he decentralized and federal, to undo the damage done by the hypercentralization of the Soviet pseudofederation. These multiple tasks of rebuilding and of new creation, moreover, are functionally interrelated, and so must be pursued simultaneously if they are to succeed individually, This is the staggering effort necessary to reconstitute the civil aquarium smashed in 1917.

zh: 在如此困难的境况下，不能排除以威权统治作为捷径，用来强行加快市场化和国家建设的步伐；这条道路被称为皮诺切特方案或中国方案。但这样一种可能，是否会否定市场与民主之间的必然联系——而自由企业的长期辩护者们曾得意地宣称，这种联系正是苏联崩溃的教训？随着民主社会主义的拥护者质疑后共产主义欧洲最初迅速的经济自由化步伐，并敦促对经济转型采取更缓慢的“中间派”方针，这个问题必将引发激烈争论——上一章已经指出，这种论点混合着学术关切与政治关切。
en: In such difficult circumstances, the shortcut of authoritarian rule is not to be excluded as a means of forcing the pace of marketization and nation building, a path that has been called either the Pinochet or the Chinese scenario. But would such an eventuality negate the necessary relationship between the market and democracy that long-time advocates of free enterprise have triumphantly proclaimed to be the lesson of the Soviet collapse? This matter is certain to be hotly debated as advocates of democratic socialism challenge the initial rapid pace of economic liberalization in post-Communist Europe and urge a slower, “centrist” approach to economic conversion—a line of argument advanced with the mixture of scholarly and political concerns noted in the previous chapter.

zh: 关于这个棘手问题，经验记录有力地支持若干概括：第一，现在已经很明显，不存在也永远不可能存在任何政治民主与命令经济并存的例子。第二，确实存在威权政权下没有政治民主而市场经济成功的例子，但这并不证明市场与威权主义有有机亲和性；它只表明威权政权可以容纳一块极权政权无法容纳的自由空间。第三，不存在
市场驱动经济的政治民主例子；这包括一切所谓的民主社会主义，例如瑞典的民主社会主义，它只是调节而非压制市场或私有财产。第四，极端管制和巨型福利计划确实容易逐渐滑向赤裸裸的命令经济，而且随着时间推移，已证明有害于效率和增长。因此我们必须得出结论：确实存在一个从民主社会主义一直延伸到完全国家主义类型的连续谱。
en: In regard to this vexed issue, the empirical record strongly suggests a number of generalizations: First, it is now obvious that there are not, and never can be, any examples of political democracies with command economies. Second, there have indeed been examples of successful market economies under authoritarian regimes without political democracy, but this does not prove that the market has an organic affinity with authoritarianism; it only demonstrates that authoritarian regimes can accommodate a space of freedom that totalitarian ones cannot. Third, there are no examples of political democracies

a market-driven economy; and this includes all so-called democratic socialisms, such as Sweden’s, which only regulate but do not suppress the market or private property. Fourth, extreme regulation and mega-welfare programs do tend to shade off into outright command, and over time they have proved detrimental to efficiency and growth. We therefore must conclude that there does exist a continuum of democratic socialism with the full, statist brand.

zh: 但如果我们反向追溯国家主义的连续谱，从西班牙到智利、韩国和台湾的历史经验表明，没有民主的市场是一种暂时状态，而从长远看，市场社会需要宪政政府和政治多元主义才能以最佳方式运作。几乎所有实现持续增长的社会，迟早也都民主化了。因此，俄国若要真正现代化，就必须完成八月革命为她设定的所有多重任务。所谓“中间派”试图回收部分苏联遗产，只会延缓、甚至颠覆这一现代化进程。真正的问题不是俄国应当以自由主义还是“中间派”方式退出共产主义，而是她在没有中间威权阶段的情况下实现市场与民主的逻辑结合的机会有多大。
en: But if we trace the continuum of statism in reverse, historical experience from Spain to Chile to South Korea to Taiwan indicates that the market without democracy is a temporary condition, and that in the long run a market society requires constitutional government and political pluralism in order to function in optimal fashion. Sooner or later almost all societies that achieve sustained growth have also democratized. Thus, if Russia is to be truly modern, she will have to complete all of the multiple tasks that the August Revolution has set for her. So-called “centrist” attempts to recycle part of the Soviet heritage will only slow, and perhaps subvert, this process of modernization. The real question is not whether Russia should take a liberal or “centrist” exit from Communism, but, rather, how good are her chances of achieving the logical combination of the market with democracy without an intermediate authoritarian stage.

zh: 在这项事业中，俄国在苏联中断之后相对于1914年的主要优势，是新的人口和社会结构。这个国家如今已经工业化、识字率达到高水平，且75%是城市人口；此外，它拥有熟练劳动力和一流的技术知识分子。这个社会的“中产阶级”构成了比1914年时更广泛的市场民主潜在支持群体。在这方面，现代化理论多少有些道理。
en: In this undertaking the chief advantage that Russia possesses after the Soviet hiatus, as compared with 1914, is a new sociological profile. The country is now industrialized, literate, and 75 percent urban; moreover, it has a skilled labor force and a first-class technical intelligentsia. The “middle classes” of this society constitute a broader potential constituency for a market democracy than what the country offered in 1914. And in this respect modernization theory has something of a point.

zh: 但道理也仅此而已。因为与社会科学假设相反，后共产主义的俄国并不是一个“发达”或“现代”社会——按照现代化理论本身通常对此种地位的定义。更糟的是，当社会主义者把现代化理论应用于俄国时，“发展”本应在党的“上层建筑”之下铺设一个“基础”，从而终于让列宁主义得以民主化
——这当然没有发生。因此，俄国畸形的现代性这一整个问题，现在必须重新思考。
en: But only something of a point. For contrary to social-scientific supposition, post-Communist Russia is not a “developed” or a “modern” society, as modernization theory itself generally defines that status. To make matters worse, as modernization theory has been applied to Russia by socialists, “development” was supposed to put a “base” under the Party “superstructure” and thereby at last permit Leninism to democratize
—something that of course did not happen. So the whole problem of Russia’s skewed modernity must now be thought through anew.

zh: 俄国确实是工业化和城市化的，但这并不意味着她具备现代性的全部复合体。首先，庞大的工业——更确切地说是军事工业——部门、功能失调的农业部门与几乎未发展的服务业部门之间存在剧烈失衡。与此同时，俄国昔日的主要资产，即工业部门，在现代世界市场上基本上没有竞争力；而就她确实参与该市场而言，也只是作为武器生产者，或像某个第三世界国家那样作为原材料出口者。此外，后共产主义俄国还遭受现代最严重的生态灾祸，这一状况将需要大规模投资和重建。因此总体而言，后苏联经济处于可与二战后德国和日本经济相比的崩溃状态；实际上俄国的情况更糟，因为她过时的厂房设备仍然完好，而且仍对环境造成致命危害。
en: Russia is indeed industrial and urban, but this does not mean that she partakes of the full complex of modernity. To begin with, there is a radical disequilibrium between an elephantine industrial—or rather military-industrial—sector, a dysfunctional agricultural sector, and a barely developed service sector. At the same time, Russia’s onetime main asset, the industrial sector, is essentially noncompetitive in the modern world market; and insofar as she does participate in that market, she does so as a producer of arms or, like some Third World country, as an exporter of raw materials. Moreover, post-Communist Russia is stricken with the worst ecological blight of the modern age, a circumstance that will necessitate massive investment and rebuilding. Thus, overall, the post-Soviet economy is in a state of collapse comparable to that of the German and Japanese economies after the Second World War; indeed, Russia’s situation is worse, since her obsolete physical plant is still intact and still environmentally lethal.

zh: 此外，现代市场社会需要除工厂之外的一整套制度网络，而俄国缺乏这些。这样的制度清单包括：拥有支票簿和信用卡的多样化银行体系、独立的研究与统计机构、保险公司，当然还有真正的服务业。同样重要的是商法与合同法体系，以及能够执行这些法律的法律制度。发展其中每一项都需要大量时间，教育人民养成使其运作所需的新思维习惯也同样耗时。
en: Furthermore, a modern market society requires a whole network of institutions, over and above factories, that Russia lacks. A short list of such institutions would include a variegated banking system with checkbooks and credit cards, independent research and statistical institutions, insurance companies, and of course a genuine service sector. Just as important is a body of commercial and contract law and a legal system capable of administering it. Developing each of these takes much time, as does educating the people in the new mental habits needed to make them work.

zh: 在这方面，苏维埃主义最令人衰弱、最反现代的影响，是对民众心态的影响：它留下了一种由嫉妒滋生的平均主义，一种把创业视为“投机”的怀疑，一种对行政命令而非市场激励作出反应的反射，以及马克思列宁主义教条投在批判性思维习惯上的沉闷阴影。除此之外，还要加上一种压抑的意识：无边的牺牲只换来国家的失败，国家按民间说法“七十年走在通往乌有的路上”，白白浪费了光阴。
en: And on this score the most debilitating and antimodern aspect of Sovietism has been its effect on the population’s mentality: It left behind an envious egalitarianism, a suspicion that entrepreneurship is “speculation,” the reflex of responding to administrative commands rather than to market incentives, and the dulling pall cast by Marxist-Leninist dogma over habits of critical thought. To these must be added the depressing awareness that boundless sacrifices had only produced a national failure, and that the country had wasted, in the folk phrase, “seventy years on the road to nowhere.”

zh: 因此，苏联的“发展”与其投入的努力相比，留给新俄国的可资凭借之物少得令人沮丧；而剩下的大部分也必须重建，国家才能运转。仅仅放开价格和把现有工业私有化，并不足以到达市场社会：必须建立一整套新经济制度，并创造全新的产业。此外，尽管共产主义已经消失，共产党人仍然在那里，工厂经理、集体农庄主席和地方苏维埃干部等任命制官员仍然管理着大部分经济和相当大一部分国家。因此，“转型”不会是从苏联发展向“正常”发展的连续过程；它毋宁将是一场持续一代人的巨大工程：淘汰旧工厂和旧人员，同时使国家重新工业化，并按现实存在的现代性方式重新教育民众。社会主义建设的巨额成本在相当大程度上被浪费了，而后苏联俄国——实际上还有长期发达的东德和波希米亚——将像西西弗斯一样，不得不在接近山脚处重新开始劳作。
en: Thus, Soviet “development,” in proportion with the effort expended, has left the new Russia with distressingly little to build on; and much of what is left will have to be rebuilt to make the country functional. It will not be enough to liberate prices and privatize existing industry to arrive at a market society: a panoply of new economic institutions must be built and whole new industries must be created. Moreover, although Communism is gone, the Communists are still there, and the

of factory managers, kolkhoz chairmen, and local soviet functionaries still manages most of the economy and administers much of the country. Thus, the “transition” will not be a continuum from Soviet to “normal” development; rather, it will amount to a gigantic, generation-long phasing out of old plants and personnel, and a simultaneous reindustrialization of the country and a reeducation of the population in the ways of really existing modernity. The inordinate cost of socialist construction was in significant measure wasted, and post-Soviet Russia—and indeed long-developed post-Communist East Germany and Bohemia as well—will, like Sisyphus, have to start its labors all over again near the bottom of the hill.

zh: 所有这一切都让人不禁设想：如果没有布尔什维克主义，俄国的发展会是什么样子。于是我们可以继续此前中断于1914年的附论，设想俄国在和平时期发生革命，从自由主义视角进行反事实历史推演。
如果我们假定宪政主义者胜利的最佳情景，就不难想象一个未被集体化的农民阶级——但不乏合作社，正如垂死的列宁所梦想的那样——因为农业合作社在他掌权并摧毁它们之前确实存在过。我们还可以设想一种国家引导的市场工业化，遵循维特和斯托雷平已经确立的、通过政府与外国投资克服落后的可靠模式。在这种情况下，俄国本会继续作为主要工业强国发展，稳步缩小与西方的差距。
en: All of this leads one to wonder what Russian development might have been like without Bolshevism. So we may resume the excursus—interrupted as of 1914 for a peacetime Russian revolution—into counterfactual history conducted from a liberal perspective.

If we suppose the best-case scenario of a constitutionalist victory, there is no difficulty in imagining an uncollectivized peasantry—but one with no lack of cooperatives, as the dying Lenin had dreamed—for agricultural cooperatives had in fact existed before he came to power and destroyed them. And we may also suppose a state-guided market industrialization in accordance with the tested pattern of overcoming backwardness through government and foreign investment already established by Witte and Stolypin. In these circumstances, Russia would have continued to develop as a major industrial power steadily closing the gap with the West.

children: 〔译注〕列宁在1923年《论合作社》中讨论了当时已经存在的合作组织；革命前合作社受到的冲击与新经济政策时期合作组织的存在，是需要区分的不同问题。
〔译注〕列宁在1923年《论合作社》中讨论了当时已经存在的合作组织；革命前合作社受到的冲击与新经济政策时期合作组织的存在，是需要区分的不同问题。

zh: 即使我们假定更可能发生的最坏情景，即出现一个俄国佛朗哥和民族威权主义，经济结果也大致相同：大量社会不平等，但也有大量经济增长，当然会有挫折和衰退，但74年之后终将是一个基本上“城市化、工业化和识字”的社会——按发展主义的套话来说——不过
加上了财产权和多元主义——简言之，一种真正现代的文化。而且俄国佛朗哥也不会持续那么几十年，这个国家现在很可能像大多数欧洲国家一样，是一个宪政民主国家。
en: Even if we suppose the more likely worst-case scenario of a Russian Franco and a national authoritarianism, the economic result would have been roughly the same: much social inequality, but also much raw growth, though certainly setbacks and recessions, yet at the end of seventy-four years a basically “urban, industrial, and literate” society, as the developmental litany goes, but

property and pluralism added—in short, a genuinely modern culture. Nor would a Russian Franco have lasted all those decades, and the country would now quite probably be, like most of Europe, a constitutional democracy.

zh: 像俄国这样幅员辽阔、自然资源丰富且具有欧洲文化的国家，无论其非共产主义政府是什么样子，到二十世纪末都绝对不可能不成为主要工业强国。那种认为共产主义是把俄国从落后带向现代所必需的论点——每当人们从现代化理论出发，尤其当它叠加着社会主义期待时，几乎总会提出这种论点——是荒谬的。这种推理反映了苏联学中真正的决定论谬误，即：因为工业化事实上以共产主义方式发生了，所以它只能以那种方式发生。恰恰相反，布尔什维克的“发展”道路是对真正发展的一次极差模仿；实际上，它在几乎所有领域——经济、文化和道德——都大体上适得其反，并在失败之后留下一个残废、发育不良、用叶利钦的话说，一个“病态”的社会。
en: There is absolutely no way a country of European culture as huge and as rich in natural resources as Russia would not have been a major industrial power by the end of the twentieth century, whatever its non-Communist government. It is absurd to argue—as is almost invariably the case when we start from modernization theory, especially when it is overlaid with socialist expectations—that Communism was necessary to bring Russia from backwardness to modernity. Such reasoning reflects the real determinist fallacy in Sovietology, to wit, that because industrialization in fact happened the Communist way, it could only have happened that way. On the contrary, the Bolshevik road to “development” was a very poor imitation of the real thing; indeed, it was largely counterproductive in almost every sphere—the economy, culture, and morality—and left behind after its failure a crippled, stunted, and, in Yeltsin’s term, a “sick” society.

zh: 与此同时，在上述两种非共产主义情景中，都无法想象会有像苏联集体化和古拉格那样愚蠢而具有破坏性的东西，也不会有像斯大林主义计划那样令人窒息、浪费巨大的国家干预市场形式。这一批评同样适用于第一个五年计划中最初偏向孟什维克的版本——它曾与布哈林一起被大肆吹捧；因为斯大林之后，苏联大体上又回到了那种类型的计划，而结果依然糟糕。
要产生计划、集体农庄和古拉格这些独特的苏联制度，最大主义社会主义的幻想和列宁主义政党的无法无天是必不可少的。
en: At the same time, what is inconceivable in either of the above non-Communist scenarios is anything so inane and destructive as Soviet collectivization and the Gulag, or any form of state intervention in the market as stifling and wasteful as Stalinist planning. And this stricture applies also to the original Menshevik-leaning version of the First Five-Year Plan, which was once vaunted along with Bukharin; for after Stalin the Soviet Union returned to planning roughly of that type, and the results were still bad.
To produce the distinctive Soviet institutions of Plan, kolkhoz, and Gulag, the illusions of maximalist socialism and the lawlessness of the Leninist Party were indispensable.

zh: 于是我们再次回到意识形态和政治在苏维埃现象中的首要地位。正如索尔仁尼琴就苏联恐怖的特殊规模所说：“莎士比亚笔下恶棍的想象力和内在力量止于十来具尸体，因为他们没有
……正是由于
，二十世纪才遭遇了使数百万人受害的恶行。”
索尔仁尼琴的这一命题同样适用于希特勒的“最终解决方案”及其集中营，而且他当然也有意如此。但在共产主义的情况中，意识形态的首要地位不仅适用于集中营，也适用于整个苏维埃事业，从其社会经济基础到其文化上层建筑。
en: So once again we return to the primacy of ideology and politics in the Soviet phenomenon. As Solzhenitsyn put the matter with respect to the unique dimensions of the Soviet terror: “The imagination and inner strength of Shakespeare’s villains stopped short at ten or so cadavers, because they had no
…. It is thanks to
that it fell to the lot of the twentieth century to experience villainy on a scale of millions.”

And Solzhenitsyn’s proposition is also valid, and was intended, of course, for Hitler’s Final Solution and his camps. But in the Communist case the primacy of ideology holds not just for camps but for the entire Soviet endeavor, from its socioeconomic base to its cultural superstructure.

zh: 当然，有人对“意识形态专政的党治制”这一“模型”提出异议：在第一代之后，苏联领导人已不是意识形态信徒，而是务实的政治家；尤其荒谬的是，认为勃列日涅夫政权受意识形态驱动。
的确，意识形态与决策的直接相关性在苏联历史进程中确实稳步下降，以至于勃列日涅夫坦率承认他听不懂苏斯洛夫的长篇大论。但按与当前政策的直接相关性来评估意识形态，是一种非常肤浅的方式：马克思列宁主义的作用方式要深刻得多。
en: To these claims for the “model” of ideocratic partocracy it has, of course, been objected that after the first generation, the Soviet leaders were not ideologues but pragmatic politicians, and, in particular, that it is absurd to view the Brezhnev regime as motivated by ideology.

Indeed, the direct relevance of ideology to decision making did steadily decline over the course of Soviet history, to where Brezhnev frankly admitted that he could not understand Suslov’s disquisitions. But viewing ideology in terms of direct relevance to current policy is a very shallow way to assess its role: Marxism-Leninism acted in a much more profound manner.

zh: 因为苏联秩序的所有基本制度——最迟在1935年已经出现——都是意识形态的创造物；它们正是用钢铁、混凝土和无所不在的党机关铸成的党纲。一旦社会主义的这些基本结构被“建成”，它们就几乎不再需要作为其运转齿轮的人保持积极的意识形态承诺——甚至不需要简单的信仰。维持制度所要求的一切，就是没有人敢于对它作过于批判性的思考；因此直到政权最后时刻，其制度仍被不懈的宣传鼓动洪流所美化，民众则被弄得麻木，那些宣传宣称国家正走在通往“光辉未来”的道路上。然而直到最后，这种僵化的意识形态也从未完全死亡。实际上，它的核心坐标—— “社会主义”对“资本主义”的优越性、两者之间永无休止的阶级斗争，以及“敌人”的无所不在——确实在政府最高层制定国家和国际政策的总路线时发挥着作用。如果没有“科学共产主义”那种包罗万象、制度化的陶醉，就不可能有现实存在的“索茨主义”（
，亚历山大·季诺维耶夫的俏皮说法）这样荒诞的事物。
en: For all the basic institutions of the Soviet order, as they had emerged by 1935 at the latest, were the creations of ideology; they were nothing less than the Party program set in steel, concrete, and the omnipresent apparat. Once these basic structures of socialism had been “built,” they hardly required active ideological commitment—or even simple belief—from the human cogs that operated them. All that was required to keep the system was that no one dare to think too critically about it; so until the very end of the regime its institutions were glorified, and the population was benumbed, by an unrelenting barrage of agitprop proclaiming that the country was on the road to the “radiant future.” Yet never, until the end, was this ossified ideology completely dead. Indeed, its cardinal coordinates—the superiority of “socialism” over “capitalism,” the unending class struggle between the two, and the omnipresence of “enemies”—were in fact operative at the highest levels of government in setting the broad lines of national and international policy. Nothing so fantastic as really existing “sotsism” (in Aleksandr Zinoviev’s
) would have been possible without the all-encompassing and institutionalized intoxication of “scientific Communism.”

zh: 因此，其崩溃的结果是在俄国社会中留下巨大的信仰和价值观真空。进入这个真空的，是各种各样的信仰和伪信仰：从传统宗教和爱国主义，到千禧年教派和狂热民族主义，再到咄咄逼人的犬儒主义与虚无主义，当然还有对西方式民主的认同。随着1989—1991年的欢欣消退，西方对新俄国的评论把注意力从这一混乱光谱中的积极民主因素和传统因素，转向了消极而有威胁的因素。然而我们不应夸大它们所构成的危险。因为这些运动没有一个具备产生共产主义那种热忱和动力的潜力；尤其是，激进的俄国法西斯主义似乎不大可能出现。而这恰恰是因为四分之三个世纪的共产主义经历。
en: The result of its collapse, therefore, was to leave a great absence of belief and values in Russian society. Into this void has moved a variety of faiths and pseudofaiths, from traditional religion and patriotism to millenarian cults and rabid nationalism to an aggressive cynicism and nihilism and, yes, to a commitment to Western-style democracy. As the euphoria of 1989-1991 waned, Western commentary on the new Russia shifted the focus of its attention from the positive democratic and traditional elements in this confused spectrum to the negative and threatening ones. Yet we should not exaggerate the dangers they present. For none of these movements has the potential for generating the zeal and drive of Communism; in particular, a militant Russian fascism is hardly in the offing. And this is so precisely because of the three-quarter-century Communist experience.

zh: 因为俄国在尝试“重返欧洲”——民主派如此表述他们的目标——时为数不多的优势之一，就是这段经历已使民众对所有意识形态政治产生免疫，并消除了任何进一步极权冒险的诱惑。自上世纪车尔尼雪夫斯基和民粹派时期激进知识分子兴起以来，俄国第一次成为一个后意识形态、甚至反意识形态的社会。这一因素，加上她以高昂代价换来的城市化和受教育的社会面貌，也许最终使俄国有可能重新缩小与欧洲之间的差距；这一进程曾被战争和1917年革命打断。
en: For one of Russia’s few advantages in attempting “to return to Europe,” as the democrats frame their goal, is that this experience has inoculated the population against all ideological politics and removed the temptation of any further totalitarian adventures. For the first time since the rise of the radical intelligentsia at the time of Chernyshevskii and the Populists in the last century, Russia is now a post-ideological, even an anti-ideological, society. And this factor, in conjunction with her dearly bought urban and educated sociological profile, may at last make it possible for Russia to resume the narrowing of the gap with Europe that was interrupted by war and revolution in 1917.

zh: 苏维埃主义之后的社会主义
en: SOCIALISM AFTER SOVIETISM

zh: 但如果社会主义之后的俄国是一片灾区，那么“实验”之后的社会主义又处于什么状态？乍看之下，社会主义本身似乎应当已经名誉扫地，人类现在可以继续务实地做生意了。确实，在1989—1991年之后紧接着，就有许多胜利主义言论，说历史在克服了法西斯主义和共产主义的幻象之后，终于抵达了市场民主的安全港湾。但一种后马克思主义的历史终结论，并不比其马克思主义前辈在1917年时更可能被证明正确。只要不平等存在，社会主义观念就必定与我们同在，而那将是非常漫长的时间。然而，社会主义几乎不可能以其先前的形式持续下去。
en: But if Russia after socialism was a disaster area, what was the state of socialism after the “experiment”? At a superficial glance, it would seem that socialism as such should have been discredited, and that mankind could now get on with the practical business of business. And indeed in the immediate wake of 1989-1991, there was much triumphalist talk that History, after having overcome the illusions of both fascism and Communism, had at last arrived at a safe harbor in market democracy. But a post-Marxist vision of the end of history is no more likely to prove accurate than its Marxist predecessor was in 1917. The socialist idea will surely be with us as long as inequality is, and that will be a very long time indeed. Yet socialism can hardly persist in its previous forms.

zh: 关于社会主义的话语迄今已经历两个大阶段。第一个阶段从1830年代社会主义道德观念的诞生，延伸到1917年后布尔什维克终于尝试给它以工具性表达。这一阶段因此产生了一种以否定现存现实为中心的理论话语，只是展望未来的正义社会。于是，社会主义首先意味着对勃列日涅夫或许会称为“现实存在的资本主义”的批判。社会主义话语的第二个阶段与苏联实验的存续期相始终，那时第一次出现了所谓的后资本主义。这一阶段产生了一种更务实的话语，以实验的工具性纲领为中心，因为这些纲领被视为与一切形式的社会主义相关，无论执政与否，无论“民主”还是独裁。因为这些纲领绝非俄国落后的特殊产物；它们是社会主义观念本身的首要逻辑推论：国有化、集体化和计划化。
en: The discourse on socialism has thus far gone through two great phases. The first extended from the birth of the moral idea of socialism in the 1830s to the Bolshevik attempt after 1917 to at last give it instrumental expression. This phase consequently produced a theoretical discourse centering on the negation of existing reality, with only an anticipation of the just society of the future. Thus socialism meant, above all, the critique of what Brezhnev might have called “really existing capitalism.” The second phase of socialist discourse was demarcated by the lifespan of the Soviet experiment, when for the first time a postcapitalism allegedly existed. This phase produced a more practical discourse centering on the instrumental programs of the experiment, since these were viewed as relevant to all forms of socialism, whether in or out of power, and whether “democratic” or dictatorial. For these programs were hardly the idiosyncratic product of Russian backwardness; they were the prime logical deductions from the socialist idea itself: nationalization, collectivization, and planning.

zh: 因此，社会主义话语的第三个、即将到来的阶段将面临的困境是：如何应对这样的事实——这些纲领既是核心观念的明显表达，同时又是一场巨大失败。人们无法回到1917年之前的天真岁月，假装苏联实验从未发生，或声称其记录无关紧要，因为它反正不是真正的社会主义。社会主义愿望若要以可信形式存续，就必须抛弃大量压舱物。而它将以这种或那种形式存续下去。
en: So the dilemma that will stalk the third, coming phase of the discourse on socialism is how to cope with the fact that these programs were the obvious expression of the core idea, and at one and the same time a monumental failure. There is no going back to the innocent days before 1917 and pretending that the Soviet experiment never happened, or that its record is irrelevant because it was not genuine socialism anyway. Much ballast will have to be jettisoned if the socialist aspiration is to survive in credible form. And in one or another form, survive it will.

zh: 在集中计划和国有化这些关键问题上，左翼已经发生了一次重大的修正主义转向。西方和第三世界的社会主义政党几乎未经任何自我反省，就突然放弃了对此类措施的倡导。与此同时，在1989—1991年之后，几乎在一夜之间、未经辩论，就出现了一种惊人的世界性共识：市场和私有财产是一切运转正常的经济不可或缺的特征；它们确实是宪政民主与法治的基础；而这一组合构成了文明现代性的自然秩序。诚然，如我们所见，对市场和私有财产的接受程度各有不同，因为一些社会思想家在清算共产主义时仍坚持“中间派”路线，仿佛希望那始终难以捉摸的“第三条道路”还能从废墟中浮现。但在1989—1991年的大崩溃之后，几乎没有人会再公然否认财产和市场。于是，关于“资本主义”的大萧条综合征大体上被克服了；卡尔·波兰尼似乎被驳倒；弗里德里希·哈耶克关于完整社会主义是一种新农奴制的论点，则似乎基本上得到证实。显然，社会思想史上的一个时代现在结束了。
en: There has already been a major move to revisionism on the Left with regard to the key matters of centralized planning and nationalization. With hardly any soul-searching Western and Third World socialist parties suddenly dropped their advocacy of such measures. At the same time, in the wake of 1989-1991, and almost overnight and without debate, there emerged an astonishing worldwide consensus that the market and private property were indispensable features of any functioning economy; that they were indeed the basis of constitutional democracy and the rule of law; and that this amalgam constituted the natural order of civilized modernity. To be sure, there were, as we have seen, degrees of acceptance of the market and private property, since some social thinkers held out for a “centrist” course in liquidating Communism, as if in the hope that the ever elusive “third way” might yet emerge from its wreckage. But after the crash of 1989-1991, almost no one would any longer deny property and the market outright. Thus the Great Depression syndrome regarding “capitalism” was largely overcome; Karl Polanyi appeared to be refuted; and Friedrich Hayek’s contention that integral socialism was a form of neoserfdom seemed essentially vindicated. Clearly, an epoch in the history of social thought was now closed.

zh: 与此同时，虽然不那么明显，那个难以捉摸的术语“社会主义”本身的含义也得到了充实。回顾起来应当清楚，我们一直面对的是一个由同样可称为“社会主义”的纲领构成的连续谱，从“民主”社会主义一直延伸到共产主义，并按财产和市场国家化的程度分级。所有这些纲领都源于同一个道德观念，其工具手段则从光谱温和一端的自愿合作社，一直延伸到硬端的列宁主义党国。
en: At the same time, though somewhat less clearly, the meaning of the elusive term “socialism” itself was fleshed out. In retrospect it should be evident that we were dealing all along with a continuum of equally “socialist” programs, One extending from “democratic” socialism to Communism and graduated according to the degree of statization of property and the market. All of these programs stemmed from the same moral idea, and they ranged in their instrumental means from mere voluntary cooperatives at the soft end of the spectrum to the Leninist Party-state at the hard end.

zh: 然而，十月在社会主义连续谱上划出了一道巨大断裂，这道断裂是由为实现所期望的退出资本主义而选择的政治手段造成的。这一断裂位于多数人执政的宪政民主与“科学的”先锋队自上而下革命之间，也就是位于社会民主与共产主义之间；而政治手段的这一差异，决定了财产和市场关系国家化的可能程度。简言之，社会主义连续谱的两大翼在手段上而非目的上存在分歧，这正是它们爱恨关系的根源：对民主社会主义者来说，共产党人是事业的叛徒，因为其手段具有强制性；而对共产党人来说，社会民主党人是叛徒，因为他们从未达到自己公开宣称的目的。
en: Yet October marks a great caesura in the socialist continuum, one cut by the choice of political means employed to effect the hoped-for exit from capitalism. This caesura falls between majority-rule constitutional democracy and “scientific” avant-garde revolution from above, that is, between social democracy and Communism; and this difference of political means determines the degree to which the statization of property and market relations is possible. In short, the two great wings of the socialist continuum differ over means but not ends, and this is the source of their love-hate relationship: to the democratic socialists, Communists are traitors to the cause because of their coercive means; and to the Communists, social democrats are traitors because they never attain their avowed end.

zh: 但不要忘记，在一般社会主义的这对
（兄弟仇敌）中，只有共产党人真正达到了社会主义在其非资本主义完整意义上的目标。世界各地的社会民主党人，在等待支持废除资本主义的选举多数等了一两代人之后，失去了信仰，放弃了其马克思主义的残余。在这方面，他们效法了老大哥党，即德国社民党1958年在巴特戈德斯贝格的先例，因为对政治民主的承诺最终扼杀了他们对完整经济社会主义的承诺。
en: But let us not forget that of the two

of generic socialism, only the Communists actually reach socialism in its full meaning of noncapitalism. The social democrats of the world, after a generation or two of waiting for an electoral majority in favor of abolishing capitalism, lose the faith and renounce the vestiges of their Marxism. In this they follow the example of the senior party, the German SPD, at Bad Godesberg in 1958, for their commitment to political democracy eventually kills their commitment to full economic socialism.

zh: 然而，社会主义连续谱内部的所有观念变化，尽管重大，都只是工具性和纲领性的：它们没有触及一切形式社会主义的核心道德理想——平等在界定正义社会时的首要地位。更重要的是，这些变化没有削弱马克思主义特有社会主义范式的深层结构；该范式把被压迫者和被剥夺者尊为人类的本真，从而把政治建立在异化与苦难那种自我充实、具有救赎性质的特征之上。因此，只能预期，托克维尔称为“民主”——即社会拉平——的那股天意力量的固有逻辑，会像1789年以来那样不可阻挡地驱动现代世界。
en: Yet all the changes in outlook within the socialist continuum, major though they were, were only instrumental and programmatic: they did not touch the core moral ideal of all forms of socialism—the primacy of equality in determining the just society. What is more, these changes did not undermine the deep structures of the specifically Marxist paradigm of socialism, which exalts the oppressed and the deprived as quintessential humanity and thereby grounds politics on the self-enriching, redemptive character of alienation and suffering. Thus the immanent logic of that Providential force which Tocqueville called “democracy”—that is, social levelling—can only be expected to drive the modern world as inexorably as it has ever since 1789.

zh: 只要不平等存在，社会就会继续分为左与右，分为“运动党”与“抵抗党”，分为把政治当作道德的阵营与把政治当作审慎和实用主义伦理的阵营。而且，这一综合征将继续被同样的情感色彩和准宗教光环所环绕。前一个阵营将继续被称为“社会主义”，因为苏联灾难之后紧接着落在那个魔力词语上的耻辱，不会持续到“资本主义”——即现实世界——的下一次危机之后。因此，以这种或那种形式，“资本主义”这头狮子与“社会主义”这头独角兽无疑将无休止地争斗下去，直到现代性的终结。
en: So long as inequality exists, society will continue to be divided into a Left and a Right, a “party of movement” and a “party of resistance,” the camp of politics as morality and the camp of politics as the ethic of prudence and pragmatism. This syndrome, moreover, will continue to be surrounded with the same emotional charge and parareligious aura as before. And the former camp will continue to be called “socialism,” for the discredit cast upon that magical word in the immediate wake of the Soviet disaster will not last beyond the next crisis of “capitalism”—that is, of the real world. So in one form or another, the lion of “capitalism” and the unicorn of “socialism” will no doubt contend inconclusively until the end of modernity.

zh: 但社会主义追求下一个阶段的新工具性纲领会是什么？哪些社会群体将构成新的普遍阶级？迄今为止，社会主义以工业无产阶级为中心，因而以国有化和集中计划为纲领。但这个所谓的普遍阶级即使在其全盛时期，也从未超过任何工业国家人口的三分之一；而且二战后，西方世界见证了工业社会的逐步解体，以及无产阶级的萎缩及其加入工会、拥有住房的残余部分的“资产阶级化”。正如当前社会科学所说，发达世界因此处于“后工业”时代，其经济日益“以服务业为主”，由计算机时代的“信息革命”驱动。在这样一个世界里，工厂工作台旁的劳动者不再是普遍阶级典范的可信候选者。实际上，他已成为工人阶层中守旧偏见的象征：奥古斯特·倍倍尔让位于阿奇·邦克——或者他上台成为那个过于人性化、而且非常反社会主义的莱赫·瓦文萨。
en: But what will be the new instrumental program of the coming phase of the socialist quest? And what social group, or groups, will constitute the new universal class? Hitherto, socialism centered on the industrial proletariat, and hence on a program of nationalization and centralized planning. But this putatively universal class even in its heyday never numbered more than a third of the population of any industrial country, and after the Second World War the Western world witnessed the progressive dismantling of industrial society together with the withering away of the proletariat and the “embourgeoisement” of its unionized, home-owning remnants. As current social science now puts it, the developed world is thus in the “postindustrial” era with an increasingly “service-dominated” economy driven by the “information revolution” of the computer age. In such a world the toiler at the factory bench is no longer a credible candidate for exemplar of the universal class. Indeed, he has become the symbol of retrograde, hard-hatted prejudice: August Bebel has given way to Archie Bunker—or he has come to power as the all-too-human and very antisocialist Lech Walesa.

zh: 但一个由受苦者和被剥夺者组成的普遍阶级、一个终结一切阶级的阶级这一观念，仍然牢牢伴随着我们。然而，它的主要所在已不再是西欧和北美的发达经济体与福利国家社会。相反，旧的马克思主义范式已经完成了它自列宁帝国主义理论以来开始的迁移——列宁把半殖民地和殖民地世界置于救赎性革命先锋的位置（毛泽东把这一转变推得更远）。既然列宁的第二世界即共产主义已经消亡，那么被视为第一世界受害者的第三世界，就构成了人类伟大的集体下层阶级。于是，剥削者与被剥削者这一永恒的两极，已从资产阶级与无产阶级的二分，转变为北半球与南半球的二分。
en: But the idea of a universal class of the suffering and the deprived, of a class to end all classes, is still very much with us. Its prime locus, however, is no longer within the developed economies and welfare-state societies of Western Europe and North America. Rather, the old Marxist paradigm has completed the migration it began when Lenin, in his theory of imperialism, privileged the semicolonial and colonial worlds as the vanguard of redemptive revolution (a transformation carried still further by Mao). Now that Lenin’s Second World of Communism is defunct, it is the Third World viewed as victim of the First that constitutes the great collective underclass of humanity. And so the eternal polarity of exploiter and exploited has been transformed from the dichotomy of bourgeoisie and proletariat into that of the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

zh: 但北半球欧洲少数与地球上众多其余人口之间的这一地理划分，与建立在种族和肤色之上的不平等相互重叠；这种划分也在北方自身的“内部第三世界”中重现。而这又关系到普遍的生物学性别划分。于是在二十世纪后期，出现了一个新的解放运动连续谱，从阶级扩展到种族，再到性别——晚近又扩展到性取向。这种多样化催生了继资本主义和帝国主义之后被关注的一系列压迫现象——阶级歧视、种族歧视和性别歧视。
这一发展在美国最为先进，这种早熟部分源于1960年代以来美国民权运动政治的相继调适。但在任何地方，这一运动都反映并放大了奴隶对主人的救赎辩证法；这种辩证法先由斯多葛主义、尤其由基督教普遍化，并在现代以马克思主义的“深层结构”获得最有力的重新表述。
en: But this geographical division between the European minority of the North and the multitudinous remainder of the planet overlaps with inequalities founded on race and color, a division reproduced in the “internal Third World” of the North itself. And this in turn is related to the universal biological division of gender. So in the late twentieth century there has emerged a new continuum of liberation movements spreading out from class to race to gender—and latterly to sexual orientation. And this variegation has spawned a series of successor syndromes of oppression to capitalism and imperialism—classism, racism, and sexism.

This development is most advanced in the United States, a precocity that derives in part from successive adaptations since the 1960s of the politics of the American civil-rights movement. But everywhere this movement reflects and amplifies the redemptive dialectic of the slave over the master, universalized first by Stoicism and especially by Christianity, and reformulated most powerfully for the modern age in the “deep structure” of Marxism.

zh: 当然，这些后无产阶级解放运动并非直接源自马克思主义。然而，它们都发展于一种浸透着马克思主义残余范畴的文化氛围中，例如法兰克福学派把马克思、尼采和弗洛伊德融合为对压制性资产阶级社会的“批判理论”，又如米歇尔·福柯的后结构主义转换，把赤裸裸的经济剥削转变为由理性主义资产阶级文化分泌的支配性话语所产生的更微妙的异化。诚然，与这些新“少数群体”相关的一切不平等和不公正问题都非常真实，正如工业工人阶级在其时代的问题也是真实的一样。但与此同时，这些问题被纳入了一种关于总体“人类解放”的对抗性形而上学，而这种形而上学超越了其一切具体表现。
en: Of course, these post-proletarian liberation movements are not direct derivations from Marxism. Nonetheless, they all developed in a cultural atmosphere permeated by residual Marxist categories, as in the Frankfurt School’s conflation of Marx, Nietzsche, and Freud into a “critical theory” of repressive bourgeois society, or in Michel Foucault’s post-structuralist transformation of brute economic exploitation into the subtler alienation produced by the discourses of domination secreted by rationalistic bourgeois culture. To be sure, all the problems of inequality and injustice associated with these new “minorities” are quite real, just as the problems of the industrial working class in its day were real. Yet at the same time, these problems have been inserted into an agonistic metaphysic of total “human emancipation” that transcends any of its concrete manifestations.

zh: 尽管如此，马克思主义范式的这些迁移产生了多重普遍阶级，但没有一个像旧时的无产阶级那样有力或具有革命潜力。因此，建立在异化新形式之上的任何社会主义纲领，都只能相应地比旧的无产阶级专政更为分散。然而不难预见，未来一切社会主义工具性纲领都会像归巢的鸽子一样，汇聚到对财产和市场的怀疑上；因为财富永远是权力，财富的不平等永远会不平等地分配权力。因此，总会存在社会压力，要求以共同利益的名义用政治权力纠正经济权力。与此同时，社会将永远面对一个困境：没有分工，因而没有持久的不平等，就不会有经济增长——而这也是为了共同利益。
en: Still, these transmigrations of the Marxist paradigm yield a multiplicity of universal classes, but none of them is as potent or potentially revolutionary as the old-time proletariat. Any socialist programs erected on these new forms of alienation, therefore, can only be correspondingly more diffuse than the old dictatorship of the proletariat. Nonetheless, it is not difficult to foresee that all future instrumental programs of socialism will converge, like homing pigeons, on suspicion of property and the market; for wealth will always be power, and inequalities of wealth will always allot power unequally. Consequently, there will always be social pressure to use political power to correct economic power in the name of the common good. At the same time, society will always confront the dilemma that without a division of labor, and therefore without enduring inequality, there will not be economic growth—also for the common good.

zh: 于是，现代性的实际问题归结为国家干预经济和社会进程的程度。从来不存在十九世纪曼彻斯特自由派所鼓吹、今日自由至上主义者手捧哈耶克仍梦想的那种纯粹市场驱动的经济。这种完整自由主义与完整社会主义一样是乌托邦。但应当强调，这种超自由主义依其反威权本性，绝不可能产生强制性的政体，而完整社会主义却总是如此。因此，在“正常”世界——位于两个乌托邦之间——苏联的失败已经表明，市场是自然社会秩序的一部分。尽管商业周期反复无常、萧条一再发生，市场对于我们获得一个有生产力且运转正常的社会绝对必要；任何废除它的尝试都会导致经济灾难和政治压迫。然而市场不能给我们正义社会。正义社会，就其可能接近而言，必须是共同体道德和政治意志作用于市场本身无关道德的力量的产物。这意味着，为道德和政治目的而干预市场运作，也是自然社会秩序的一部分。
en: Thus the practical question of the modern age comes down to the degree of state intervention in economic and social processes. There has never been a purely market-driven economy of the type that nineteenth-century Manchester liberals urged, and that present-day libertarians, Hayek in hand, still dream about. This integral liberalism is as much a utopia as is integral socialism. Yet it should be emphasized that such ultraliberalism, by its very antiauthoritarian nature, can never produce a coercive polity, as integral socialism invariably has done. Thus in the “normal” world—that which is located between the two utopias—the Soviet failure has demonstrated that the market is part of the social order of nature. Despite the vagaries of the business cycle and the recurrence of depressions, the market is absolutely necessary to give us a productive and functioning society, and any attempt to dispense with it leads both to economic disaster and political oppression. Yet the market cannot give us the just society. The just society, insofar as it can be approached, must be the product of the moral and political will of the community acting on the amoral forces of the market. And this means that state intervention in the market’s operation for moral and political ends is also part of the social order of nature.

zh: 正是这条

（中间道路），在大萧条之后成为发达国家成熟“资本主义”的常态。（实际上，希特勒和墨索里尼同一时期也推出了他们自己相当全面的福利国家版本。）现代性的这种新常态在二战后重建所催生的大繁荣中达到顶峰。于是，常态政治变成了中左派与中右派之间就美国福利国家、德国“社会市场”或法国“指示性计划”的规模和分寸进行协商的事情。从“资本主义”（cap-ism）到“社会主义”（soc-ism）的元历史过渡不再是一个真正的问题，尽管最大主义词汇的残余仍然存在。而最大主义纲领在列宁式政党的强制工具中的化身，似乎已在现代性存续期间名誉扫地。于是，西方社会主义政党抛弃了马克思，甚至抛弃了社会主义；共产党则在很大程度上改用了更温和的“社会主义”标签。
en: It is this

that became the normality of mature “capitalism” in the developed countries in the wake of the Great Depression. (Indeed, Hitler and Mussolini produced their own, quite comprehensive versions of the welfare state in the same period.) And this new normality of modernity reached its prime during the Great Prosperity that emerged from the reconstruction after the Second World War. Thus the politics of normality came to be a matter of give-and-take between a Left-Center and a Right-Center over the proportions of the American welfare state, the German “social market,” or the French “indicative plan.” The metahistorical transition from “cap-ism” to “soc-ism” is no longer a real issue, even though vestiges of maximalist vocabulary remain. And the incarnation of maximalist programs in the coercive instrument of a Leninist-type Party seems to have been discredited for the duration of modernity. Thus, Western socialist parties have abandoned Marx and even socialism, and Communist parties have largely switched to the more anodyne label “socialist.”

zh: 但这是否意味着最大主义的诱惑已一劳永逸地成为过去？几乎肯定不是。普遍阶级角色的候选者比比皆是；而且，尽管性别兼性取向肯定永远无法拔得头筹，某种由年轻、多产但贫穷的第三世界对抗富裕但老龄化的北方的组合，却有可能做到：秘鲁超现实的“光辉道路”就是这种可能性的暗示。此外，试图重返超级国家的潜力也到处存在：只要出现足够令人信服的共同利益关切，西方围绕着社会安全网规模的寻常争吵就可能升级为全面的国家化。
en: But does this mean that the maximalist temptation is once and for all behind us? Almost certainly not. Candidates for the role of universal class abound; and, although gender-cum-sexual orientation will surely never get the brass ring, some combination of a young, prolific, but poor Third World arrayed against an opulent but graying North could conceivably do so: Peru’s surreal Sendero Luminoso is a hint of this possibility. And the potential for an attempted return to the superstate also exists everywhere: the normal Western wrangling over the size of the social safety-net could escalate towards comprehensive statization if a sufficiently compelling concern for the common good appeared.

zh: 实际上，在生态这一光辉事业中，已经有一个强有力的候选者可以扮演这种催化角色。这是一个声称代表人类集体、星球利益、反对富人自私追逐利润和增长的运动。它用再熟悉不过的措辞挑战市场的“无政府状态”，使个人财产权服从于对共同利益的追求；而生态计划显然已在幕后待命。此外，生态运动的实际事业总是被表述为道德事业；在其更极端的形式中，生态学甚至演变成一场旨在拯救人类物种的运动。
en: Indeed, there is already a potent candidate for this catalytic role in the luminous cause of ecology. This is a movement that claims to speak for the collective, planetary interest of mankind against the selfish pursuit of profit and growth by the rich. In all too familiar terms, it challenges the “anarchy” of the market and subordinates individual property rights to pursuit of the common good; and eco-planning is clearly in the wings. Ecology’s practical causes, moreover, are invariably presented as moral ones; and in its more extreme forms, ecology shades into a movement for nothing less than the salvation of the species.

zh: 诚然，生态运动提出的实际问题非常真实——正如早先工人阶级的问题，以及晚近被承认的社会少数群体的问题一样真实——而常态政治当然必须处理这些问题。但再一次，而且是以一种熟悉的模式，这些实际问题被纳入了一种超越所有这些具体问题的救赎形而上学。因为乌托邦在一个不完美的世界里永远涌现；如果因为当今最伟大的乌托邦以灾难告终，就断定乌托邦政治本身已经终结，那将是愚蠢的。
en: To be sure, the practical issues raised by the ecology movement are very real—as were the earlier problems of the working class, and as are the more recently recognized problems of social minorities—and the politics of normality will certainly have to deal with them. Yet once again, and in a familiar pattern, these practical problems have been subsumed in a salvation metaphysics that transcends them all. For utopia springs eternal in an imperfect world, and it would be foolish to conclude that because the greatest utopia of our age has ended in disaster, utopian politics as such are finished.

zh: 乌托邦政治也不应当终结，因为乌托邦既危险又必要。没有夸张的希望和过度的热忱作为刺激，这个世界上很少有民主改革会被启动。右翼尽管偶尔涉足托利民主，通常害怕在推动必要的平等改革中采取主动，因此这项任务落到左翼更鲁莽的力量身上。空想社会主义的夸大其词，对于产生福利国家是必要的；福利国家正是如今界定常态政治的两股力量之间的现有平衡点。而或许，最近那场巨大的苏联灾难已经明确界定了乌托邦危险的极端形式，从而使我们对任何进一步的此类冒险产生免疫。
en: Nor is it desirable that they should be, for utopias are as necessary as they are dangerous. Without the goad of exaggerated hope and excessive zeal, very little democratic reform would be launched in this world. The Right, despite occasional forays into Tory democracy, usually fears taking the initiative in promoting necessary egalitarian change, and so this task devolves on the rasher forces of the Left. The overstatements of visionary socialism were necessary to produce the welfare state, which is the present point of equilibrium between the two forces that now define the politics of normality. And perhaps the late, great Soviet disaster has definitively defined the extreme form of the utopian danger, and so inoculated us against any further such adventures.

zh: 但谁知道呢？前所未有的列宁主义现象，是因1914—1918年前所未有的世界危机而出现的。任何类似的全球危机都可能再次把蛰伏的社会主义纲领推向最大主义，从而推向为达到绝对目的而寻求绝对权力的诱惑。只要社会主义的乌托邦愿望存在，它就永远会有两张面孔：它将充当改善一个永远不完美世界所需的刺激，也将提供用所谓完美世界强行取代这个世界的诱惑。而偶然性的悖谬狡计，将像过去一样，决定这两种相互竞争的逻辑如何展开。
en: But who knows? The unprecedented Leninist phenomenon appeared because of the unprecedented world crisis of 1914-1918. Any analogous global crisis could drive dormant socialist programs once again towards maximalism, and consequently towards the temptation of seeking absolute power in order to achieve absolute ends. So long as the utopian aspiration of socialism exists, it will always wear a dual face: It will serve as a needed goad to ameliorating an eternally imperfect world, and it will offer the temptation of forcibly replacing that world with an allegedly perfect one. And the perverse Cunning of Contingency will determine, as in the past, how these two competing logics work out.
